create_custom_sso_handler: create a custom SSO handler that returns SSOUserDefinedValues with user role and budget after IDP authentication
configure_sso_user_role: configure LitellmUserRoles.INTERNAL_USER as the default role for authenticated SSO users
set_user_budget_duration: set a max_budget of 10 with budget_duration of 1d for users authenticated via custom SSO
lookup_user_in_database: lookup user data in the Litellm proxy database using prisma_client.get_data by user ID
validate_user_id_from_idp: validate that userIDPInfo.id is not None and raise an error if the IDP returns no user ID
